items.name: TimeSeries-Anomaly-Detection
items.description: Time-series anomaly detection using LSTM autoencoders on NASA satellite telemetry data. Implements LSTM-Attention, LSTM-VAE, and Transformer models to detect system faults and irregular behaviors in SMAP & MSL datasets. Includes comprehensive EDA, model comparison, and evaluation metrics.

items.name: affiliation-metrics-py
items.description: Python 3 implementation of the affiliation metrics and tests for reproducing the experiments described in "Local Evaluation of Time Series Anomaly Detection Algorithms" [KDD 2022]

items.name: CCE
items.description: CCE: Confidence-Consistency Evaluation for Time Series Anomaly Detection, Confidence, Consistency, Evaluation, Metric, TSAD

items.name: faster-eTaPR
items.description: Faster implementation of the enhanced time-aware precision and recall (eTaPR) for the evaluation of anomaly detection methods on time series data

items.name: TSADmetrics
items.description: Evaluation metrics for Time-Series Anomaly Detection (TSAD)

items.name: stream-eval-metrics
items.description: Evaluation of anomaly detection for stream / real-time time series.

items.name: cloud_anomaly_detection
items.description: Anomaly detection on cloud service metrics: synthetic time series, Z-score and Isolation Forest detectors, evaluation and plots.

items.name: Timeseries-ML-Anomaly-Forecasting
items.description: End-to-end Python ML project: LSTM forecasting + anomaly detection on time-series metrics (with evaluation and plots)

items.name: Streamify-Time-Series-Anomaly-Detection-Methods
items.description: This project studies streaming approaches to time-series anomaly detection. It explores state-of-the-art methods, benchmarks, and evaluation metrics, while investigating how anomaly detection techniques can be adapted for real-time streaming scenarios where data arrive continuously and must be processed incrementally.

items.name: Transformer-GAN-for-Multivariate-Time-Series-Anomaly-Detection
items.description: Transformer–GAN framework for robust multivariate time-series anomaly detection using geometric masking and contrastive learning. Includes full pipeline, SMD dataset support, evaluation metrics, and Colab-ready implementation for research and publication.

items.name: anomaly-detector
items.description: Offline time-series anomaly detection — Isolation Forest + optional autoencoder, deterministic synthetic generator, CLI, and evaluation metrics.

items.name: Hybrid-Transformer-GAN-for-Multivariate-Time-Series-Anomaly-Detection
items.description: Hybrid Transformer–GAN framework for robust multivariate time-series anomaly detection using geometric masking and contrastive learning. Includes full pipeline, SMD dataset support, evaluation metrics, and Colab-ready implementation for research and publication.

items.name: tensorflow-100-days-49-time-series-anomaly-detection
items.description: Project 49 of 100 Days of TensorFlow: Time-series anomaly detection utilizing an LSTM Autoencoder. Features synthetic data generation with injected anomalies (spikes, freezes, noise bursts), MinMaxScaler scaling, sequence reconstruction, dynamic thresholding, Precision/Recall/F1 metrics evaluation, and a visual dashboard.

items.name: smart-ambulance-anomaly-detection
items.description: Smart Ambulance anomaly detection system for real-time patient vitals monitoring using time-series machine learning. Includes artifact handling, early warning detection, risk scoring logic, alert evaluation metrics, and a deployable ML API service designed for safety-critical ambulance environments.
